risks.risk: Year (2024) may be incorrect; year affects value and buyer risk.
risks.proof: Photo of dashboard VIN/year plate or registration/inspection document showing year (or a clear VIN plate photo).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-confirmed year (worst case: treat as unknown/possibly older).

risks.risk: TRD 4x4 trim/4WD variant may not match; photos don’t confirm TRD/4x4 specifics.
risks.proof: Photo of TRD badge/trim label (if present) + 4WD selector/controls + VIN decode/spec sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as V6 Tacoma with trim/4x4 not confirmed (worst case: not TRD/4x4).

risks.risk: Push-to-start may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Interior photo showing push-button start + short video starting the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Price as push-to-start not confirmed (worst case: not working/not present).

risks.risk: Moonroof may be absent or faulty.
risks.proof: Photo of roof/moonroof + video opening/closing it.
risks.if_unproven: Price as moonroof not confirmed (worst case: not working/not present).

risks.risk: Duty/clearance may be incomplete or incorrect, causing import/registration issues.
risks.proof: Clear photos/scans of duty receipt and clearance/release documents (with verification stamps if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as duty not verified (worst case: buyer may need to regularize).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition may not be perfect despite seller claim (hidden faults, transmission/4WD issues).
risks.proof: Cold-start video + dashboard warning lights check + OBD scan report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needs inspection/possible faults (worst case: not guaranteed working perfectly).

risks.risk: Accident/repair history not provable from exterior photos (repaint, frame issues, panel gaps).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of panel gaps + underbody/frame inspection photos.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible repair risk (worst case: accident/repair not ruled out).

proof_requests: VIN plate photo (dashboard or door jamb) and a document showing exact model year (2024).
Photo of TRD/4x4 identifiers and the 4WD selector/controls (plus VIN decode/spec sheet).
Interior photos: push-button start area and roof/moonroof controls; short video demonstrating moonroof operation.
Cold-start video, OBD scan results, and undercarriage/frame inspection photos.
response.reason: The seller’s “I tested it” reply is not proof without videos/documents. The provided photos still don’t confirm the major pricing drivers (2024 year, TRD 4x4, push-to-start, moonroof, verified duty, and mechanical condition).
